changes.what: geomBox now verbatim from sketch-constraints-r4/remeasure-fixtures.mjs (arcs contribute END points only). The earlier copy added the arc circle boxes, scaled the jitter about 1.35x and drew a different start.

(1) images are no longer de-duplicated by bbox alone (bbox + loop signature), and a build is scored against the passing image NEAREST the drawing: a mirror image of a symmetric slot is the same solid and is now MATCH, not MATCH-OTHER-SIDE. (2) a rule-free circle is scored against the DRAWN circle (pi r^2 H, bbox c+-r, bars 3e-4 / 2e-3 mm fixed beforehand), not the stored circle of another radius.
Guarded tallies now keep OTHER-SIDE apart from WRONG (they folded MATCH-OTHER-SIDE into WRONG).
brep-rs column scores a rule-free circle as drawn (same oracle rule).
Free circle (no rules) labelled 'built-as-drawn (free circle, no rules)' using the drawn-circle closed form, instead of 'different-solid'.
Sentence key mask /[-0-9.e+]+/ also replaced every letter e (row 120 sentence 'Arc # has an #nd...'); now masks numbers only and keeps the raw first sentence, which the row uses.
No longer overwrites sketch-constraints.json: it reads it and writes sketch-constraints-recheck-r4.json. Verified: build-rows.mjs then recheck leaves sketch-constraints.json byte-identical.
